messages:
morgan: Heads-up — saw a spike in failed decryptions after the roles/permissions refactor canary landed in us-east-1. Audit logs for several service accounts show actor_id=null. Rolling canary? Need eyes.

ana: Saw the same on dashboards (errors spiked ~09:12 UTC). Affected: internal-batcher, metrics-ingest-svc.

dev-bot: Deploy event: roles-schema-v3 canary -> us-east-1 by @morgan at 09:10 UTC :deploy:

ravi: Is this the int->uuid role id switch we shipped? If grants.role_id still points at numeric ids, joins will return nulls. Could explain actor_id gaps.

morgan: Quick query to spot orphans:
```sql
SELECT g.id, g.actor_id, g.role_id, r.id as role_id_match, r.uuid
FROM grants g
LEFT JOIN roles r ON g.role_id = r.id
WHERE r.id IS NULL
LIMIT 50;
```

sx: Yup. If role ids changed shape, LEFT JOIN will fail and downstream lookups (audit service -> role -> kms_policy) break. Do we have a backfill running?

tal: Backfill status shows 3/9 shards completed. shard-2 failed with:
`ERROR: invalid input syntax for uuid: "12345" at migration role_migration_shard_2`

lia: KMS side also noisy — audit-service decrypts are failing because role->kms_policy mapping is missing for those grants, so the call short-circuits with permission denied.

morgan: Immediate plan: pause canary, roll back roles-schema-v3 on canary nodes in us-east-1, don't drop old columns yet, fix migration/backfill, then resume. Anyone object?

ravi: +1 to pause. I'll prepare a safe backfill to coerce int ids to uuid via lookup table rather than direct cast. Proposed backfill snippet:
```sql
UPDATE grants g
SET role_id = lookup.uuid
FROM role_id_lookup lookup
WHERE g.role_id = lookup.legacy_int_id
AND g.role_id::text !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$'; -- skip already-uuids
```

ana: I'll open an incident ticket and page infra/support. @ops-bot can you run the rollback playbook?

ops-bot: Rollback initiated: starting rolling revert of roles-schema-v3 canary in us-east-1. Estimated time to completion: ~8 minutes. :gear:

sx: While paused, DO NOT run the migration cleanup that drops legacy columns. We'll need legacy columns for the backfill and audit backfill.

tal: :thumbsup: Also add a KMS policy audit — verify no keys had permissions permanently revoked; record any denial events.

morgan: Good call. After rollback and backfill we need sanity checks:
- run sample decrypts for internal-batcher and metrics-ingest-svc
- run console RBAC routing checks (canary vs prod model)
- run audit backfill to populate actor_id where possible

ravi: I'll also prepare an audit backfill for actor_id using actor_lookup table: 
```sql
UPDATE audit_log a
SET actor_id = l.actor_id
FROM actor_lookup l
WHERE a.actor_key = l.key
AND a.actor_id IS NULL;
```
I'll include a dry-run mode first.

lia: I'll own console/e2e tests once backfill completes. Ping me when finish.

ravi: PR in progress to fix the migration casting bug for shard-2; should be ready in ~10m.

morgan: Thanks all. Assigning owners: ravi -> backfill & migration patch, lia -> post-backfill tests, ana -> incident comms, sx -> DB ops/rollback. I'll drop logs and follow-up steps in the incident doc. Marking canary paused.

ana: Noted. Will update incident ticket and external comms channel.

ops-bot: Rollback complete on canary nodes (us-east-1). Confirmed no schema-only destructive steps executed.

morgan: OK — next steps: run ravi's backfill on a staging replica, validate, then schedule a controlled resume with smoke tests. Keep the thread updated.
